title: Physics-Guided Multi-Fidelity Surrogate Modeling for Natural Supercavity Geometry of an Axisymmetric Conical Cavitator
abstract: arXiv:2610.18886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural supercavitation behind conical cavitators generates a vapor-filled envelope that, when sustained over the full body of a high-speed underwater vehicles, reduces hydrodynamic skin-friction drag and enables performance levels unattainable in fully wetted flow. Accurate prediction of maximum cavity length and maximum cavity radius and local cavity profile as functions of cavitation number and cone half-angle is essential for both the static design and the real-time shape management of super-cavitating torpedo cavitators. Classical analytical models provide computationally inexpensive predictions but exhibit systematic disagreements in the practically important regime of moderate cavitation number and large angle, where slender-body assumptions begin to break down. Existing data-driven machine learning approaches offer higher accuracy but are constrained by the prohibitive cost of multiphase computational fluid dynamics (CFD) sweep

translated_title: 面向轴对称锥形空化器自然超空泡几何形态的物理引导多保真度代理建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.18886v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：锥形空化器后方产生的自然超空泡会形成一个充满蒸汽的包络层，当其在高速水下航行器的整个弹体表面持续存在时，能够降低水动力摩擦阻力，并实现全湿流状态下无法达到的性能水平。准确预测最大空泡长度、最大空泡半径以及局部空泡轮廓随空化数和锥半角变化的函数关系，对于超空泡鱼雷空化器的静态设计和实时形状管理而言都至关重要。经典解析模型虽然计算成本低廉，但在实际工程中非常重要的中等空化数和大锥角工况下会表现出系统性偏差，此时细长体假设开始失效。现有的数据驱动机器学习方法虽然能够提供更高的精度，但受到多相计算流体力学（CFD）参数扫描高昂计算成本的制约。
tldr: 该论文提出一种物理引导的多保真度代理建模方法，用于预测轴对称锥形空化器的自然超空泡几何形态，在解析模型精度不足与多相CFD计算成本过高之间取得平衡，从而支撑超空泡鱼雷空化器的静态设计与实时形状管理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-guided multi-fidelity surrogate modeling approach for predicting the natural supercavity geometry of axisymmetric conical cavitators, balancing the systematic errors of analytical models against the prohibitive cost of multiphase CFD, thereby supporting both static design and real-time shape management of supercavitating torpedo cavitators.
